note: First published schema of the messages of the ACP adapter (AC-1), generated from AcpAdapterDocument in cli/src/acp/types.ts on release/v1.3.0: what a client may send that Nexus acts on (initialize, session/new, session/load, session/prompt, session/cancel, $/cancel_request, _nexus/receipt/get, and the reply to session/request_permission) and what Nexus sends (results, errors, session/update with agent_message_chunk, user_message_chunk, tool_call, tool_call_update and session_info_update, and session/request_permission). It describes Nexus's subset of the Agent Client Protocol version 1 plus Nexus's own extension method and _meta members, not ACP itself. Nothing was published before it. Types and pure functions only in this change: no command speaks these messages yet. Experimental: names and fields may change, each change with an entry here.

Add the ACP `_nexus/verify` request and result contract, plus retrieval of its session-bound verification receipt through `_nexus/receipt/get`. The caller supplies only an active session id; verifier settings are fixed by the operator. This is an additive adapter-schema version; the previous published schema remains unchanged.
Add the objective inference-submission budget stop reason and continuation usage fields to the ACP turn-result contract. Additive adapter-schema version; v1 and v2 remain unchanged.

The `_nexus/verify` result names what it covered: three new required members, `workspace` (the canonical path of the session's directory, as in the receipt), `base_pinned_commit` and `base_pinned_at` (the commit the change was measured from and when this process pinned it for that workspace). Requests are unchanged. Additive for a client that reads results; v1, v2 and v3 remain unchanged.

Description-only update: clarify that sandbox denial profile labels reflect SB-1 named profiles when present and default otherwise. The schema structure and validation contract are unchanged; schema_version remains 4.
